_provenance: History vectors and the first seven delta vectors: frozen in Task 1 by executing the then-shipped backend.app.services.stock_forecast_alerts.{history_rate,delta_rate}, and reproduced unchanged by backend.app.services.forecast_engine ever since. The delta vectors after them were measured on the engine when its delta tier became the span formula (2026-11-15, upstream 1d86cff5a / #3407). Do not edit by hand; regenerate only when the engine's math is the thing that deliberately changed: python -m backend.tests.forecast_vectors.generate_vectors

history.name: two_adjacent_days
history.comment: The minimal measurable history: one inter-day observation, one day apart.

history.name: two_days_with_a_five_day_gap
history.comment: One observation across a 5-day gap — the gap divides the newer day's grams.

history.name: six_events_across_four_days_mixed_grams
history.comment: Six events, three spools, four distinct days, uneven grams and gaps.

history.name: decay_curve_0_15_30_60_90_days_old
history.comment: Same grams at 0/15/30/60/90 days old — the frozen mean and spread encode the decay curve.

history.name: single_day_refuses
history.comment: Two events on one calendar day: no gap to measure, the tier must refuse.

history.name: single_record_refuses
history.comment: One event alone can never yield a rate.

history.name: interleaved_spools_one_sku
history.comment: Two spools of one SKU interleaved — same-day events sum across spools before bucketing.

history.name: half_life_pair_weight_at_thirty_days
history.comment: One observation exactly 30.0 days old (weight 1/2) against one 0 days old (weight 1) — the frozen mean pins the 30-day half-life without reaching into internals.

history.name: zero_gram_events_give_a_zero_rate
history.comment: Zero-weight events on two days: a measured rate of 0.0 with 0.0 spread — NOT a refusal.

delta.name: one_spool_ten_days
delta.comment: 100 g over 10 days — the plain fallback.

delta.name: baseline_aware_reset
delta.comment: 'Reset usage to 0': only post-reset grams count (900 used, 800 baseline over 10 days).

delta.name: oldest_spool_anchors_the_window
delta.comment: Two spools: the OLDEST created_at divides the group's total.

delta.name: younger_than_a_day_refuses
delta.comment: A group younger than one day has no measurable window.

delta.name: over_reset_clamps_to_zero_and_refuses
delta.comment: baseline above weight_used clamps to 0 consumed, so alone it refuses.

delta.name: over_reset_spool_does_not_poison_the_group
delta.comment: An over-reset spool contributes 0, not a negative — the healthy spool's grams survive intact.

delta.name: shelf_time_before_first_use_is_not_use
delta.comment: Entered 150 days ago, first printed with 10 days ago: 100 g over 10 days, not over 150.

delta.name: use_that_ended_before_the_window_measures_zero
delta.comment: 600 g used between 400 and 300 days ago and nothing since: nothing was used in the last 90 days.

delta.name: a_span_across_the_window_edge_counts_its_inside_part
delta.comment: 900 g spread evenly from day -135 to day -45: half lies inside the 90-day window, 450 g / 90 d.

delta.name: a_spool_used_up_in_one_day_counts_whole_at_that_day
delta.comment: 200 g first and last used within two hours, 5 days ago: all of it, observed for 5 days.

delta.name: a_spool_used_up_before_the_window_keeps_the_window_whole
delta.comment: One spool emptied 200 days ago, another opened 10 days ago: the SKU was in use all along, so the new spool's 100 g is 100 g per 90 days — not per 10.

delta.name: a_last_use_in_the_future_ends_now
delta.comment: A clock that ran ahead stamped last use tomorrow: the span ends now, 100 g over 10 days.
